items.title: Narvin Kimball Interview, 1961-11-25
items.q: He played trombone in that band.

ctx.x: He played trombone in that band. He was a, he was a, uh, quite a personable fellow. He, uh, I can always remember, he used to kid me and tell me about my being the youngest one in the group. And that, uh, when we would go out on the road somebody would kidnap me and leave beyond that. We, we traveled one time down to Delco Island to play.
Did he, uh, did Joe Petit play slide or the valve? Slide. I know he started out on the valve, I guess most of the new ones.
